facts.statement: The type species Transylvanosaurus platycephalus is known only from a fragmentary skull.
facts.quote: The type species is Transylvanosaurus platycephalus, known from a fragmentary skull.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was discovered in 2007 in the Pui Beds of the Haţeg Basin in Romania.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen, LPB (FGGUB) R.2070, was found in 2007 in the 'Pui Beds' in the Bărbat River Valley section of Haţeg Basin, Hunedoara County, Romania.

facts.statement: The fossil material consists of a fragmentary skull containing an articulated basicranium and frontals.
facts.quote: It consists of a fragmentary skull, including the articulated basicranium and articulated frontals.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses place Transylvanosaurus within the family Rhabdodontidae in an unresolved relationship with other members.
facts.quote: In their phylogenetic analyses, Augustin et al. (2022) recovered Transylvanosaurus as a member of the Rhabdodontidae, in an unresolved polytomy with most other rhabdotontids.

facts.statement: Researchers proposed a close relationship to Rhabdodon based on morphological comparisons.
facts.quote: Despite these results, the authors proposed especially close relationships to Rhabdodon based on morphological comparisons.

facts.statement: The fossils date to the middle Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: This locality is dated to the middle Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period.

facts.statement: Transylvanosaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Transylvanosaurus belongs to the parent group Rhabdodontomorpha.
Transylvanosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.

rejected.statement: Transylvanosaurus is an extinct genus of rhabdodontid ornithopod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Romania.
rejected.quote: Transylvanosaurus (meaning "lizard from across the forest") is an extinct genus of rhabdodontid ornithopod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous (Maastrichtian) Hateg Basin of Romania.

rejected.quote: In 2022, Transylvanosaurus platycephalus was described as a new genus and species of rhabdodontid ornithopod dinosaurs by Felix J. Augustin, Dylan Bastiaans, Mihai D. Dumbravă, and Zoltán Csiki-Sava based on these remains.
